authority_note: Proposed registry only. Do not treat as enforced or approved until governance review, schema validation, CI enforcement, and SSOT reconciliation are evidenced.

records.title: Establish ARR lifecycle, ownership, and evidence-gated acceptance

scope.summary: Define a governed, auditable ARR process for ecosystem-level architecture and software requirements without duplicating canonical implementations.

records.requirement: Every in-scope ecosystem architecture/software requirement must be represented by a versioned ARR record, linked to canonical ownership, measurable acceptance criteria, exact-SHA evidence, and explicit residuals. Approval remains subject to the applicable governance authority.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Governance approves the authority model and lifecycle states.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Recorded independent governance review and approval.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The ARR record schema validates valid fixtures and rejects malformed records.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Automated positive and negative schema tests bound to the exact PR SHA.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The registry is reconciled with existing standards and decision registries so no competing SSOT is created.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Documented registry ownership and cross-registry consistency review.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Required CI checks fail closed on invalid ARR records and missing exact-SHA evidence.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Workflow logs showing the checked-out source SHA, validator results, and negative-test failure behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing in-scope requirements are migrated or tracked as explicit residuals.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Inventory report with source references and coverage totals.

ssot_references.version_or_revision: current approved revision; verify at implementation
main revision to be bound during review

residuals.description: Schema validator, negative tests, and fail-closed CI enforcement are not included in this documentation/schema proposal.
Registry ownership and cross-registry SSOT reconciliation remain to be reviewed against the currently approved registry standard.
